text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I am the daughter of a certain enka
singer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And when I was still a child, I made a
promise.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It was an extremely important promise
with my
best friend, Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
A big race, huh? So you wanna run in
one too,
Dia!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Same here! I wanna make everyone smile
while
running, just like how my dad
makes people smile
with his singing!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dia? Why do you wanna run in
races?

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text:
Um... I wanna win a G1 race. I think
that's the
reason why I was born.

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! Let's both go to Tracen, then!
We'll be
able to run together there if we
do!

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kita! Okay, it's a promise! Let's run
in the
Classic Triple Crown too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I had Dia, of course, but I also met an
Uma I
really admired. She inspired me to
become just
like her.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Tokai Teio! Tokai Teio is the
champion of the
Satsuki Sho! We just
witnessed a glimpse of her
magnificent
talent here, folks!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaall right! That's one crown down!
The legend
of the Invincible Teio is just
getting started!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio is my role model and I aspire to be
like her,
while Dia is my dear friend who
runs alongside
me. And my father is a
person I've always
respected.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so lucky. I'm surrounded by people
who can
help me achieve my dream, and
I love every
single one of them. And
now...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All I gotta do is see things to the end!
I'm gonna
be an Umamusume who puts
smiles on people's
faces!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Traineeer! I'm sooo sooorry!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant, huff! I can't believe it... I can't believe I'm late on the first day of the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I stopped to help push a
minivan that got
stuck on a slope and
didn't notice the time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the Umamusume I'm in charge of,
Kitasan
Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's the type that simply can't walk
away from
someone in need, and if I had
to say what her
biggest strength is...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Raaah! Two ramp sprints down, one more
to go!
I'm nowhere near done yet!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant... Whew... I'm exhausted!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd say it's her hardiness and ability to
withstand
intense training. We'll be
challenging the Twinkle
Series with that
strength of hers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Good job, Kita. You're working so hard
already.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dia! And of course I am. I've been
waiting
my whole life for this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is Satono Diamond, Kitasan Black's

childhood friend and the daughter of
the Satono
family, which runs a large
company of the same
name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When they were young, they promised
each other
to run in the Triple Classic
Crown together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You might have beat me in registering
for the
series...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But I'll catch up with you in a heartbeat.
And once
I do, let's do our best... as
peers.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I may be one step closer than you
to
debuting, but you're way more
knowledgeable
when it comes to stuff
like racing strategy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I still have a lot to learn, but I've gotta
get to the
point where I can run ahead
and pull Dia along
like I used to when
we were young.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, let's practice on a wood
chip
track, Trainer! I can still keep going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she's still inexperienced,
Kitasan Black
is earnest, focused, and
highly resilient.
Slumbering within her is
unlimited potential for
growth.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm going to be strict, okay.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not very graceful, and I've only got
my
tenacity going for me... But my desire
to make
people happy is greater than
anyone's!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to stay positive, keep moving
forward,
and give it my all until the very
end!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's right, it all begins here. This is the
path to
realizing my dream!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'll be running my very best
alongside
Dia and Teio on the grandest
of stages!
